field_text_formatted.value: End the target with ;token=[preview_token], and in settings.php name its consumer with 'consumer' => 'my-frontend'. Each Preview then adds a token to the fragment. It acts as the editor, limited to that role, for 15 minutes by default. It travels without a cookie, so CORS can allow any origin: without credentials, another site reads only what an anonymous visitor could. The config changes two lines:
